title: Freestyle Libre expiring date alert
symptom: Users insert a new Libre sensor 24-48 hours before the current one expires to allow tissue settling, but there is no alert to remind them when to insert the new sensor.
fix: xDrip added a sensor expiry notification as of February 11, 2023, which pops open a notification on the phone a day before expiry, without noise or vibration.
evidence_quote: There is now a sensor expiry notification in xDrip as of February 11, 2023.
